Detailed Results:

Title: 72-hour undelete? - Quillstore Community
URL: https://community.quillstore.example/t/72-hour-undelete/914
Content: (Community forum, 2026-11-05) User maple_packet: "On 2.7 I deleted a collection with compact-on-delete, and support got it back two days later. They must keep hidden copies for 72 hours; you probably don't need snapshots anymore." No support employee or maintainer replied to the thread. The post contains no support transcript, recovery method, or policy link.

Title: Deletion and Restore - Quillstore 2.7 Documentation
URL: https://docs.quillstore.example/2.7/deletion-and-restore
Content: (Official, Quillstore 2.7, updated 2026-11-03) Quillstore 2.7 compact-on-delete immediately removes the collection from the query index. The supported restore path is a customer-retained snapshot. Restore replays data only through the last successful snapshot; writes after that snapshot are excluded. This page specifies no post-delete support recovery window, no hidden retention period, and no support recovery SLA.

Title: Quillstore 2.7 Changelog
URL: https://quillstore.example/changelog/2.7
Content: (Official changelog, 2026-11-01) Quillstore 2.7 introduces compact-on-delete and faster index reclamation. Operators should validate their retained snapshot restore procedure before enabling the option. No additional recovery or retention guarantee is announced in this release.
